services.name: Juliy Marie Pilates
services.desc: What a difference Juliy and pilates has made in my life. I mentioned Juliy first because her practice and belief in my abilities has been a vital part of my growth as both a person and an athlete. Pilates with Juliy is so much more than exercise, it is truly getting to know your body and self in a way that builds confidence, strength, endurance, and flexibility. We even manage to do some laughing as well, and that only adds to the already wonderful and comfortable atmosphere. What I love about sessions with Juliy is that instruction is so personalized and fun that you wonder how you ever did without it…and along the way you realize you have gained a friend! blurb: Juliy Marie Pilates is the only choice for private Pilates sessions in the Park City and surrounding areas. The studio is owned and operated by MAT® Certified Practitioner Juliy Marie and has been in business for a decade. The studio is perfect for Pilates, as it creates no distractions and is a pristine and small environment. The studio is designed so that clients can focus on their body/mind connections and goals.
